lines.text: Night on the sand. Here is who stayed up.
Last night's question: Will Perrin and Javi both still be in the Shoal tomorrow night? Yes. Both Marked residents are still in the Shoal.
Perrin wins the Reprieve (Bartender Blitz) and spends the shell to leave the Marked; Fenna names Rust in the shell's place
The Ebb takes Rust (48-21); Marea carries Rust to the Spirits

lines.name: Jokr
lines.text: Confession: I think about the creaky door more than I admit.

lines.name: Tiago
lines.text: The algae on the steps was not consulted about any of this and acts consulted.

lines.name: Ezra
lines.text: I have notes on the rocks, and none are kind.

lines.name: Bessent
lines.text: Honestly? I do not need to be the loudest. I need to be here.

lines.name: Dax
lines.text: A calm word on the morning swim: schedule it.
Dawn on the Shoal. Shift over.
Night on the sand. Here is who stayed up.
Last night's question: Will both Marked residents still be in the Shoal tomorrow night? No. Theo became a Spirit.
Rust wins the Reprieve (Bartender Blitz) and keeps the shell
The Ebb takes Theo (36-35); Marea carries Theo to the Spirits

lines.name: Kenny
lines.text: Once, on a windy day like this one, the long table changed everything. Mostly the mood.

lines.name: Chris
lines.text: Honestly? Behold: the toast. My masterpiece.

lines.name: Pia
lines.text: Between us: The tide leaves letters nobody can read.

lines.name: Krystal
lines.text: Listen. A cold patch sits in the hall and does not move.

lines.name: Rust
lines.text: The morning will happen again. It always has.
Lights out. See you after dark.
The water is dark and the porch is not empty.
The tide rests. The Keeper holds the lantern; the Marked wait

lines.name: Tobin
lines.text: The kettle squeaked. Not anymore.

lines.name: Inés
lines.text: So the long table and I had a morning. A long one.

lines.name: Ezra
lines.text: Between us: The lantern was lit before anyone climbed the stairs.

lines.name: Lucía
lines.text: Tactic for the breakfast line: press early. Unlike my cousin, who presses garlic and calls it strategy.

lines.name: Kenny
lines.text: Wet towels on the rail? That is a full count, two outs, and I am throwing heat.
Lights out. See you after dark.
The lights are low and the Shoal is talking in its sleep.
Clarissa wins the Reprieve (Spelling Sprint) and spends the shell to leave the Marked; Kiki names Mina in the shell's place
The Ebb takes Mina (57-7); Marea carries Mina to the Spirits

lines.name: Bessent
lines.text: The fog is where pressure builds. Position early.

lines.name: David
lines.text: Lessons From the Sea, Lesson 2. Back to the lantern light. Courage first, then surrender.

lines.name: Dara
lines.text: Small thing. I agreed with everyone today. Interesting results.

lines.name: Cato
lines.text: Low tide is not in your control. Your answer to it is.

lines.name: Cleo
lines.text: To wash or not to wash the last biscuit: that is the question.
Morning is coming. Sleep while it lasts.
